title: How to "Skip" Regions in Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: ShadowStalkerTM

textNotes.text: You'll still need to complete all the main quests to access Kuldra, but these region skips can make the gameplay and progression more interesting.
These "Skips" allow you to access the other regions which let's you farm those enemy drops, salvages, chest loot, and merchants which would otherwise not be available at this stage of the game.

The main attraction of these skips imo, is that you are able to kill the Black Knight Titan basically as soon as you make your character and go there, and with the 100% safespot you can kill him naked with the lowest tier staff (but it'll take like 20min lol, you'll need alot of runes and multiple staves due to durability), it's required to start the quest in Umbral Sands, but the main benefit of …
